Introduction

Euijin is a South Korean singer and rapper under Wan Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group BIGFLO and a former member of A.cian and the project group UNB.

He made his debut as a soloist on June 26, 2019 with his first mini album E:motion.

He is also known for being a former contestant on the competitive survival shows The Unit and Kookmin Singer.
